crossRefs.note: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

translations.web: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.
translations.bsb: For many bore false witness against Jesus, but their testimony was inconsistent.
translations.kjv: For many bare false witness against him, but their witness agreed not together.
translations.asv: For many bare false witness against him, and their witness agreed not together.
